build_SelfAttentiveCNF: build a SelfAttentiveCNF model with configurable hidden dims, aux dim, and l2 attention for spatial event sequences
run_SelfAttentiveCNF_logprob: run SelfAttentiveCNF logprob to compute conditional log probabilities for event times and spatial locations
create_SelfAttentiveCNF_spatial_conditio: create a spatial conditional log probability function from SelfAttentiveCNF for evaluating log likelihood at a given time
build_SelfAttentiveODEFunc: build a SelfAttentiveODEFunc with multihead attention blocks, actnorm layers, and gated residual connections for ODE integration
test_ActNorm: test the ActNorm layer to verify invertible activation normalization with automatic batch statistics initialization
